start.selection: first device-0 PP0 alloc_extend_kernel in the first PP0 chunk containing the request

ends.token_ready: SGLang request_finished_ts; a first-token-ready proxy because every measured request generated exactly one token

excluded_intervals: client-side connection-pool and transport time before SGLang server receive
SGLang API dispatch and internal scheduler queue time before request admission/dequeue
CPU scheduler admission/dequeue to the first device-0 alloc_extend_kernel launch
estimator.proxy_limitation: forward_entry_time was not logged. The GPU marker is trace-exact but begins after CPU admission/dequeue, so this is GPU-service queue-free TTFT and cannot recover the omitted CPU forward-entry-to-first-GPU interval.
estimator.request_contract: 815 successful one-token requests; completion_tokens=1 and finish_reason=length
estimator.mapping_method: Sort measured requests by request_received_ts (identical to Receive log order), page-pad each uncached suffix to 64 tokens, consume observed PP0 #new-token rows sequentially under FCFS, and validate every inferred request boundary against PP0 #new-seq and #cached-token.

primary.definition: Existing report stable service completion cohort: client request_end_epoch_s in [1785239234.6046374, 1785239313.6046374); 44 requests.

full_run.definition: All 815 measured successful one-token agent-cache requests; health checks and pre-profile smoke requests excluded.
